The Villa

Built on the edge of the ravine, facing nothing but canopy

Villa Savana steps down the hillside above Ubud in three levels, each one opening onto the pool and the jungle beyond it. The architecture stays quiet — white volume, teak, glass — so the ravine stays the view from every room.

Five suites, an open-air living pavilion, a private billiards room, and a pool that runs almost to the treeline. Each suite is furnished on its own, but they all face the same ravine.

Experiences

What a stay here is actually for

A short list, built around the ravine, the pool and the quiet.

Three-Tier Infinity Pool

One continuous line of water stepping down the ravine, lit by candles after dark.

Open-Air Pavilion

A vaulted living and dining pavilion with no walls facing the pool — breakfast happens here, over the treetops.

Private Billiards Room

A full-size table in its own glass-walled room, banana leaves pressing against the windows.

Garden Baths

Open-to-sky bathrooms with soaking tubs and rain showers set among live palms and cactus walls.

Boho-Luxe Suites

Canopy beds, driftwood sculpture and hand-carved headboards — no two suites furnished alike.

Poolside Cabana

A shaded lounge platform at the pool's edge, built for the hour before dinner.

Private Chef

In-villa dining under the pavilion's pendant lamps, menus built around what's fresh that morning.

Airport Transfer

Private car from Ngurah Rai, arranged with your booking.
